flags.why: The example defines Tốn instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Ông ấy gieo được quẻ Tốn. = He cast the Xun trigram.

flags.why: The example explains what a dầu tree is instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Chúng tôi nghỉ dưới gốc cây dầu. = We rested under a dipterocarp tree.

flags.why: The restriction 'non-constricting' is false because snakes called rắn can also kill by constriction, as illustrated by [rắn ráo](https://tudien.dolenglish.vn/ran-rao-tieng-anh-la-gi).
